title: Flow World Re-entry Packet
description: Portable handoff shape for passing current working coordinates between a human and one or more AIs without treating prior conclusions as authority.

current_position.description: Where the work currently is. Describe position, not a retrospective summary.

confirmed.description: Items supported strongly enough to carry forward as confirmed within the stated boundary.

unknown.description: Questions or facts that remain unresolved. Do not fill these by inference.

boundary.description: Limits on what may be claimed, reused, or acted on from this packet.

question.description: The unresolved point this probe is intended to move.

observation.description: The smallest concrete observation to make next.

why.description: Optional reason this probe has high information value.

next_probe.description: At most one next probe. Null is valid when no justified probe has been chosen.

sources.description: Where carried-forward claims came from. A source entry does not by itself make a claim confirmed.
